items.heading: Poulet Nyembwe
details: Key ingredients: chicken, palm nut cream, garlic, chili
Brown chicken pieces with garlic and onion.
Add palm nut cream and simmer into a rich orange sauce.
Season with chili and cook until the chicken is tender.
Serve the stew over rice or plantains.

items.heading: Odika Stew
details: Key ingredients: wild mango seeds (odika), fish or meat, chili
Grind odika (wild mango) seeds into a thick paste.
Simmer the paste with fish or meat and a little water.
Cook slowly until the sauce becomes glossy and sticky.
Serve the rich stew over rice.
